The '''Gormak Lands''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that was dominated by the hostile [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Located to the south of the mountain [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]], the Gormak Lands were home to the Gormak city [[Gorma-Koss]], and was the main staging ground for Gormak attacks on the Voss.
